IPL 2026 Ball-by-Ball Analytics Report

A comprehensive ball-by-ball analysis of the IPL 2026 season covering batting, bowling, extras, and dismissal patterns across all matches.
Dataset-driven, delivery-level analysis. No fabricated values.
Tournament Overview & Match SummaryBatting Performance AnalysisBowling Performance AnalysisTeam Performance ComparisonExtras & Bowling DisciplineVenue & Match Phase Insights

Goal

Provide cricket analysts and team strategists with granular insights into scoring patterns, bowler effectiveness, dismissal trends, and team performance dynamics derived from delivery-level data to inform tactical decisions and fantasy cricket predictions.

Reproducibility

All figures and tables are computed directly from benchmark/data.csv. No external data is used. Calculations adhere to cricket legality conventions where possible: legal balls exclude wides and no-balls; balls faced exclude wides.
